prompts.sentence: The city will ___ the new parking rules from June.
prompts.explain: Aplicar una norma es enforce. Apply es solicitar algo.

prompts.sentence: I want to ___ for the marketing position.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es apply: presentar una candidatura.

entries.note: Apply sí funciona para cremas y para "apply to a case". El error es usarlo por "hacer cumplir".

prompts.sentence: The ___ of the novel is hard to follow.
prompts.explain: El argumento de una historia es the plot. Argument es una discusión.

prompts.sentence: They had a loud ___ about money.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es argument: una pelea verbal.

prompts.sentence: The hotel offers every modern ___.
prompts.explain: Comodidad es comfort o convenience. Commodity es una materia prima.

prompts.sentence: Oil is the most traded ___ in the world.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es commodity: un bien que se comercia.

prompts.sentence: The player has a strong athletic ___.
prompts.explain: La complexión física es build. Complexion es el cutis.

prompts.sentence: She has a fair ___ and burns easily in the sun.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es complexion: el tono de la piel.

prompts.sentence: She gave a one-hour ___ to the students on Tuesday.
prompts.explain: Una conferencia (una charla) es a lecture o a talk. A conference es un congreso de varios días.

prompts.sentence: Two thousand researchers attended the annual ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es conference: un congreso con muchos participantes.

prompts.sentence: They decided to ___ the company for negligence.
prompts.explain: Demandar en los tribunales es to sue. Demand es exigir.

prompts.sentence: The workers ___ better conditions.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es demand: exigir con firmeza.

prompts.sentence: The news left her deeply ___.
prompts.explain: Un disgusto es being upset. Disgust es asco físico o moral.

prompts.sentence: The smell of the rotten fish filled me with ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es disgust: repugnancia.

prompts.sentence: The kids had a lot of ___ at the party.
prompts.explain: Diversión es fun. Diversion es un desvío.

prompts.sentence: There's a ___ ahead because of roadworks.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es diversion: hay que tomar otra ruta.

prompts.sentence: The book was rejected by three ___ before it sold.
prompts.explain: La editorial es the publisher. An editor es quien revisa el texto.

prompts.sentence: My ___ suggested cutting the first chapter.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es editor: trabaja sobre el manuscrito.

prompts.sentence: He solved the problem with surprising ___.
prompts.explain: Facilidad es ease. A facility es una instalación.

prompts.sentence: The new sports ___ opens next month.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es facility: un edificio o instalación.

prompts.sentence: Sales reached a record ___ last quarter.
prompts.explain: Aquí figure es una cifra numérica, el uso más frecuente.

prompts.sentence: As a well-known ___, she avoids social media.
prompts.explain: Para una personalidad se dice public figure, no solo figure.

prompts.sentence: His jokes are really ___.
prompts.explain: Gracioso es funny. Gracious es cortés y generoso.

prompts.sentence: She was ___ in defeat and congratulated the winner.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es gracious: elegante y cortés.

prompts.sentence: His ___ made him an easy target for the scam.
prompts.explain: Ingenuidad es naivety. Ingenuity es capacidad inventiva.

prompts.sentence: The design shows remarkable ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es ingenuity: creatividad para resolver problemas.

prompts.sentence: Every ___ of the building received the notice.
prompts.explain: Para un edificio se usa resident. Inhabitant suena a censo o geografía.

prompts.sentence: The island has fewer than 200 ___.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí encaja inhabitant: población de un lugar.

entries.note: No es un falso amigo de significado sino de registro: inhabitant es correcto pero formal.

prompts.sentence: Could you ___ the gift in blue paper?
prompts.explain: Envolver un paquete es wrap. Involve es implicar.

prompts.sentence: The job will ___ some travel.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es involve: conlleva viajar.

prompts.sentence: This room is ___ than the other one.
prompts.explain: Mayor (comparativo) es bigger o larger. Mayor en inglés es el alcalde.

prompts.sentence: The ___ opened the new library yesterday.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es mayor: quien gobierna la ciudad.

prompts.sentence: The programme aims to reduce extreme ___ in rural areas.
prompts.explain: La miseria económica es poverty. Misery es sufrimiento emocional.

prompts.sentence: The injury made his life a ___ for months.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es misery: padecimiento.

prompts.sentence: The label says the juice contains no ___.
prompts.explain: Conservante es preservative. Preservativo es condom.

entries.note: Error de alto riesgo social: pedir "preservatives" en una farmacia no da lo que esperas.

prompts.sentence: I sent a formal ___ for more information.
prompts.explain: Una petición normal es a request. A petition lleva firmas.

prompts.sentence: Ten thousand people signed the ___ against the closure.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es petition: un documento con firmas.

prompts.sentence: My son's maths ___ at school is very patient.
prompts.explain: El profesor de colegio es a teacher. Professor es un cargo universitario alto.

prompts.sentence: She was appointed ___ of physics at Cambridge.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es professor: rango académico universitario.

prompts.sentence: She started her ___ business at twenty-five.
prompts.explain: Propio (de uno mismo) es own. Proper es adecuado.

prompts.sentence: You need ___ shoes for hiking.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es proper: el calzado adecuado.

prompts.sentence: The discovery had a ___ impact on the field.
prompts.explain: Relevante como "importante" es significant. Relevant es pertinente al tema.

prompts.sentence: Please only include ___ information in the report.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es relevant: lo que viene al caso.

prompts.sentence: If you ___ four from ten, you get six.
prompts.explain: Restar es subtract o take away. Rest es descansar.

prompts.sentence: You look tired — you should ___ for an hour.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es rest: descansar.

prompts.sentence: Chemistry is my hardest ___ this year.
prompts.explain: Asignatura es subject. Signature es la firma.

prompts.sentence: The contract needs your ___ at the bottom.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es signature: firmar el documento.

prompts.sentence: I paid with my credit ___.
prompts.explain: Tarjeta es card. Target es un objetivo.

prompts.sentence: The team missed its sales ___ this year.
prompts.explain: Aquí sí es target: la meta fijada.
